latest.title: U.S. budget deficit surged in July to highest level since March 2021
latest.description: Beyond the big single-month jump, the collective red ink over the 10 months of the fiscal year rose to nearly $1.8 trillion, surpassing the same period in 2025.

latest.title: Bitwise cuts 14% of staff while still expecting growth
latest.description: Crypto companies from including Coinbase, BitGo, Robinhood, Polygon and Pump.fun have announced workforce reductions this year, citing a variety of reasons, including shifting to AI and market forces.

latest.title: 'Nobody wants it': Lettuce prices see record-setting plunge as cyclospora spooks consumers
latest.description: Lettuce prices posted their sharpest month-over-month decline on record as diners reconsider the vegetable amid the cyclospora outbreak.

latest.title: Here's the inflation breakdown for July 2026 — in one chart
latest.description: Costs remain elevated for consumers, however inflation is showing some signs of easing, economists say.

latest.title: Wendy's stock jumps on report of potential takeover bid from Nelson Peltz's Trian Fund Management
latest.description: Peltz's relationship with Wendy's dates back to an activist campaign he led more than two decades ago.

latest.title: SpaceX short sellers are running out of bullets as stock rebounds more than 30% off low
latest.description: Short interest in SpaceX fell to about 11% of the company's publicly traded shares Wednesday, down sharply from a peak of 34% last week, according to S3.

latest.title: Goldman Sachs leaps into bitcoin income ETFs with $2.25 billion NEOS buyout
latest.description: The $2.25 billion deal expands Goldman’s derivative platform to $130 billion in total ETF assets, taking direct aim at BlackRock's rival BITA fund, according to an analyst.

latest.title: Fidelity Files to Let Its Ethereum ETF Stake and Pay Investors
latest.description: The Boston asset manager's FETH would stake up to 100% of its ETH and distribute the rewards to holders as quarterly cash, pending SEC approval.

latest.title: Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner buy Los Angeles Lakers at a $12.5 billion valuation, source says
latest.description: Venture capital founder Joshua Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger acquire Mark Walter's stake in Los Angeles Lakers at valuation of more than $12 billion.

latest.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit one day after filing
latest.description: Following the initial lawsuit, at least one of Kalshi’s event contracts was changed to list “Primary Source Agency” as the entity behind verifying flight cancellation data.

latest.title: Bank of England tests stablecoin, digital pound interoperability in cross-border payments
latest.description: The Digital Pound Lab is testing a cross-border trade finance flow combining stablecoin payments with simulated digital pound settlement.

latest.title: Home Depot CEO taking temporary medical leave, two top execs to run the retailer
latest.description: Home Depot's CEO, Ted Decker, is taking a temporary medical leave of absence that's expected to last a few months.

latest.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 puts Gemini at center of AI phone battle with Apple
latest.description: Google is launching the Pixel 11 lineup weeks before Apple rolls out a rebuilt Siri powered by Gemini AI models.

latest.title: Wintermute plans $1 billion AI push beyond crypto: Bloomberg
latest.description: The firm aims for non-crypto markets to drive over 50% of revenue by 2027, up from 10% currently, as it seeks to diversify its business.

latest.title: Strait of Hormuz ship traffic near three-month low as U.S.-Iran deal in doubt
latest.description: Traffic is about 90% lower than the daily average of 130 ships that transited Hormuz before the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

latest.title: Trump sued over Truth Social advance access sale
latest.description: The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, notes that Trump's posts on his own social media site often move financial markets.

latest.title: Trump officials float cut to capital gains tax on home sales. What it could mean for homeowners
latest.description: Trump officials may be considering a tax break for homeowners selling their primary residence in the lead up to the midterm elections.
